summary: Square bass (openDAW's Neon preset): hollow square-wave synth bass for synthwave, electro, chiptune-ish pop
label: Square Bass
body: Eighth-note and arpeggiated lines in MIDI 28-48.

Register: MIDI 28-55 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: openDAW/Square Bass, openDAW's factory preset for Neon: make_instrument (sound "openDAW/Square Bass") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
